steps.title: Configure Application Metadata
steps.description: Establish baseline properties for Sleek Calc app name and package namespace mapping.

steps.title: Establish Build Script Configuration
steps.description: Set up build.gradle with correct SDK 34 targets, Gradle 8.5 configuration, and native libraries with zero external dependencies.

steps.title: Define Color Assets
steps.description: Set up an attractive, premium dark mode palette with indigo highlights and crisp modern button variations.

steps.title: Define String Resources
steps.description: Establish user-facing string labels, button values, and loader texts.

steps.title: Create Styles and Themes
steps.description: Build modern clean Material styling mappings overriding standard light/dark parameters.

steps.title: Design Number Button Background
steps.description: Create high-fidelity rounded shape with solid fill and press states for standard keypad digits.

steps.title: Design Operator Button Background
steps.description: Design an elegant orange tint selector drawable to emphasize arithmetic operation buttons.

steps.title: Design Action Button Background
steps.description: Create specialized drawables for custom clear (AC), backspace, and control functionalities.

steps.title: Create Modern Displays & History Backgrounds
steps.description: Create high quality border and rounded card drawables for calculations display screen and sliding history view.

steps.title: Develop Layout Interface XML
steps.description: Assemble responsive Grid/Linear button layout, floating overlay history list, and immersive introductory loader screen.

steps.title: Implement Manifest Parameters
steps.description: Configure system requirements and launch activities with clean relative naming paths.

steps.title: Build Application Controller (MainActivity.java)
steps.description: Write core calculation engine, simulated intro loader handler, ToneGenerator synthesized sounds, and local scrollable history drawer operations using clean Java 8 syntax.

steps.title: Building Sleek Calc
steps.description: Trigger final asset collection, code compilation, resources optimization, and system test execution.
